messages:
maya_cs: Quick heads-up — we had a partial outage affecting hosted inference in us-west-2 starting ~11:08. Affects ~8 paying accounts. Need a short customer-facing update + timeline for RCA. @liam_csm can you own outreach?

liam_csm: On it. Do we have confirmed scope and recovery ETA? Customers are already asking.

diego_se: Root cause: regression in autoscaler that allowed stuck inference workers to saturate GPUs. Engineers rolled the hotfix at 11:40; traffic normalized by 11:52. We still have increased error rate for a few minutes while caches warmed.

maya_cs: Good. Drafting now — keep it non-technical, emphasize mitigations. We should also offer credits for >30m downtime and schedule 1:1s for top 3 impacted accounts.

priya_pm: Draft suggestion below. Please edit:

```
Hi — we’re sorry for the disruption earlier today. Between 11:08–11:52 PT some customers experienced elevated errors and latency for hosted inference in us-west-2. Our team identified and rolled a fix; full service returned by 11:52 PT. We’re continuing to monitor and will provide a detailed RCA by EOD. If you’d like a 1:1 briefing or credit for any downtime >30 minutes, reply to this message or contact cs@redwood.ai.
```

liam_csm: That reads well. Add: we’ll include a short technical appendix for customers who want details, and list impacted account IDs in the private thread.

diego_se: Technical appendix (for private use only):
```
- Cause: autoscaler bug that didn’t reclaim hung worker processes, leading to GPU exhaustion.
- Mitigation: hotfix rolled to autoscaler; queued jobs drained; workers restarted.
- Next steps: add better health probes and a kill-switch for hung workers; will validate in staging this week.
```

maya_cs: I'll send the customer-facing note in 10 min and start targeted outreach to the 3 highest-impact accounts. Liam, can you send the credit offer template and capture responses in the tracker?

liam_csm: Yep — will paste template here and add to the shared sheet.

alerts-bot: Incident update: Hosted inference (us-west-2) — Service status: Degraded at 11:08 PT, Partial Recovery at 11:52 PT, Monitoring. Incident ID: INC-20260320-42.

maya_cs: Thanks. After we send, collect feedback and any asks re: SLA or contract implications. We'll include the RCA link once ready.

priya_pm: I’ll compile the RCA draft and ping eng for sign-off. Aim: EOD send.

liam_csm: Outreach done for top 3 — two asked for 1:1s, scheduled tomorrow. Capturing credit requests in tracker.

maya_cs: Great work — keep this thread updated with any account escalations or new asks.
